definitions.explanation: A flat, typically round container used for serving or eating food. Can refer to the dish itself or the food served on it.

examples.japanese: {皿|さら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{皿|さら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: The white plate is pretty, isn't it?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{皿|さら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This plate is hot, so please be careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皿|さら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please arrange the food on the plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、{皿|さら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you finish eating, please take the plates to the kitchen.

notes:
{皿|さら} refers to flat dishes used for serving food. Can mean both the plate itself and a serving of food.

POLITE FORM:
Often used with polite prefix お: お{皿|さら}

COUNTER:
Plates are counted with ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧:
- ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{皿|さら}: one plate
- お{皿|さら}⟦{二枚|にまい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧: two plates

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{皿|さら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash dishes
- お{皿|さら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧: to serve on a plate
- ⟦{一皿|ひとさら}→一皿：noentry⟧: one dish/serving

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{皿洗|さらあら}い→皿洗い：13667_saraarai⟧: dishwashing
- ⟦{大皿|おおざら}→大皿：04477_oozara⟧: large serving plate
- ⟦{小皿|こざら}→小皿：04476_kozara⟧: small plate (for soy sauce, etc.)
- ⟦{灰皿|はいざら}→灰皿：02930_haizara⟧: ashtray
